en.title: The Sky's Boundary, Our Shot Line
en.premise: Once the ace of the basketball team, a certain incident drove me away from the court, leaving me to simply drift through the passing days. But then she appeared: a bright yet clumsy transfer student, burdened by a 'curse'—a constitution that makes it impossible for her to lie. Her presence begins to forcibly restart my stopped clock. In the twilight after school, atop the promised hill, I rediscover the passion I thought I had lost, and the true feelings I could never find the words to express.

zh.title: 天空的边界，我们的投篮线
zh.premise: 曾是篮球部王牌的我，因某次事件离开了球场，如今只是在虚度光阴。出现在我面前的，是一位性格天真烂漫却有些笨拙的转校生，她身上背负着名为“无法撒谎体质”的“诅咒”。她的出现，开始强行拨动我那停滞不前的时钟。在放学后的黄昏，于约定的山丘上，我找回了本以为早已失去的热血，以及那些无法言说的真心。
